review_notes: This rubric doesn't apply to the file. I read all 93 lines. A search for `def`, `structure`, `abbrev`, `class`, `instance` and `inductive` returned no matches. The file declares only two theorems: `sum_selected_cells_le_overlap`, a bound for weighted double sums with bounded overlap, and `manuscript_geometric_residue_energy`. The only other bindings are proof-local `let`s (`J`, `w`) inside the second proof, and they are not part of the file's API. So the file introduces no concept, representation or API that could compete with something in Mathlib, Lean core or Batteries. The rubric explicitly excludes standalone theorem duplication and proof shortening. That means even a Mathlib-style double-counting lemma that matched `sum_selected_cells_le_overlap` would be out of scope. All the concepts the file uses (`manuscriptResidueEnergy`, `histogramWindowCells`, `channelFineCount`, `fullPrimeMass`, and so on) are defined in imported files, so they would be reviewed there, not here.
